title: Satellite aviation map of military areas and low-level routes near Spooner, Wisconsin
description: Screenshot of an online satellite aviation map with an "Aviation Symbols" legend (military base, airport, military operations area, special use airspace, low-level training routes) and red route lines marking low-level flight areas across the region, with Lake Superior at top. Text above states "Spooner is in the center and Trego, the location of the witness, is only 9 miles away from that location." Below the map is the heading "Weather report: Visibility > 7 Miles."
